candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from payment authorization calls timing out: gateway traces show POST payment to /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s), propagating 502 to /v1/orders and /v1/checkout, while inventory/redis calls succeed.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-service-side metrics or logs; root cause within payment (latency vs saturation) not established.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment authorization ReadTimeouts causing 502s on checkout/orders, with inventory and redis healthy; metrics confirm 502s only on /v1/checkout with elevated p95 latency. Bounded to downstream payment latency.
